core_mechanic: Systems-driven world where the player invents their own goals from the toolset.
player_motivation: Express intent through the system; make the world your story.

essential_feel.system_legibility: every verb has a predictable, composable effect
essential_feel.tool_density: primary verbs combine into emergent strategies

pacing_profile.early: Exposed verbs and tutorial scenarios introduce systems.
pacing_profile.mid: Player adopts self-set goals; designer steps back.
pacing_profile.late: End-game sandboxes (creative mode, modding, seed sharing).

progression_model.completion_definition: Player-defined; the studio ships systems, not a finish line.
progression_model.content_cadence: Per tool / per system update; player-driven goals refresh continuously.

canonical_examples.title: Minecraft
canonical_examples.what_makes_it_special: Block-grid + crafting tree creates infinite player goals from a handful of verbs.

anti_patterns: Systems with hidden rules the player cannot infer
Persistence that breaks under player creativity (save corruption)
